evidence.quote: Shares of the world's leading chipmaker dropped 12.6% between June 2 and July 2, and they're down 17% from May's all-time high of $235.74/share.
evidence.one_line: Author reports NVDA shares fell 12.6% between June 2 and July 2, 2026, and are down 17% from May's all-time high of $235.74.
evidence.speaker: John Bromels

evidence.quote: The company's road to being the largest company in the world with a $4.7 trillion market cap hasn't been a smooth one.
evidence.one_line: Author states Nvidia's market capitalisation is $4.7 trillion, making it the largest company in the world.
evidence.speaker: John Bromels

evidence.quote: Between November 2021 and October 2022, Nvidia's share price plunged 66%.
evidence.one_line: Author states NVDA share price fell 66% between November 2021 and October 2022.
evidence.speaker: John Bromels

evidence.quote: The company went on to experience nine drops of 15% or more between July 2023 and March 2026, about three per year.
evidence.one_line: Author counts nine NVDA drops of 15% or more between July 2023 and March 2026.
evidence.speaker: John Bromels

evidence.quote: But over the last five years, the stock has risen by more than 851%.
evidence.one_line: Author states NVDA stock rose more than 851% over the last five years.
evidence.speaker: John Bromels

evidence.quote: between October 2025 and March 2026, Nvidia's stock lost 20% of its value over five months. Then, without warning, shares surged 42.7% between March 30 and May 14, hitting all-time highs.
evidence.one_line: Author states NVDA lost 20% from October 2025 to March 2026, then surged 42.7% between March 30 and May 14, 2026.
evidence.speaker: John Bromels

evidence.quote: after five of its last eight earnings reports, the stock has seen an immediate and significant share price decline.
evidence.one_line: Author says NVDA shares fell immediately and significantly after five of its last eight earnings reports.
evidence.speaker: John Bromels
